title: Lucky By Chance
tagline: Decentralised reward distributor, lottery etc with Luck By Chance Dapp.
description: This project is about decentralized gleam.io where people connect their wallets and participate in any competition. They have completed some tasks follow on Twitter, Telegram,  Discord, etc. Everyone connects their wallet at a specific time how long the competition will run. After that winner will be automatically announced and they will get a reward in their wallet directly.
how_its_made: This project was made using Solidity for smart contract for frontend I have used React and for testing and compile and deploy I have to use Truffle. Luck By Chance project smart contract is deployed on polygon chain on testnet. Due to some error, I didn’t complete the front-end. I will work on this project after this hackathon. We have also some future plans by adding new features to the Dapp.
